label: DESIGN-EV-05
command_argv:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,yaml
root=Path.cwd()
task=root/'handoffs/evaluator_executor/HNA-EVIDENCE-REOPEN-20261116'
plan=json.loads((task/'acquisition_plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
contract=(task/'CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
validation=yaml.safe_load((task/'VALIDATION_PLAN.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
frozen=task/'FROZEN_INPUTS.json'
frozen_sha=hashlib.sha256(frozen.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
acs=set(re.findall(r'^### (AC-\d{2})',contract,re.M))
assert acs==set(a for c in validation['checks'] for a in c['ac'])
assert len(acs)==5 and len(validation['checks'])==3
for check in validation['checks']:
 assert check['mandatory'] and check['expected_exit_code']==0
 if '--frozen-sha' in check['command']:
  assert check['command'][check['command'].index('--frozen-sha')+1]==frozen_sha
inputs=[]
for route in plan['routes']:
 assert route['owner']=='Executor'
 content=''
 for name in route['local_inputs']:
  p=root/name
  assert p.is_file(),name
  inputs.append(name)
  if p.suffix=='.json':content+=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
 for url in route['seed_urls']:
  assert url in content,(route['id'],url)
  assert url not in plan['blocked_urls']
assert sum(r['document_read_limit'] for r in plan['routes'])==plan['document_read_limit']==7
links=[]
for p in [task/'CONTRACT.md',root/'handoffs/执行包完善_取证路径与责任闭环_20261117.md']:
 for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
  if not ref.startswith(('https:','http:','#')):
   assert (p.parent/ref).is_file(),ref
   links.append(ref)
assert not (task/'evidence/acquisition_receipt.json').exists()
assert not (task/'REPORT.md').exists()
print(json.dumps({'status':'execution_packet_ready_not_executed','acceptance_criteria':len(acs),'validation_checks':len(validation['checks']),'frozen_manifest_sha256':frozen_sha,'local_input_bindings_checked':len(inputs),'seed_urls_from_existing_sources':sum(len(r['seed_urls']) for r in plan['routes']),'local_links_checked':len(links),'remaining_public_read_limit':7,'new_search_limit':0,'actual_receipt_or_report_created':False,'product_implementation_changed':False},ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
